items.summary: CRO disposition: retain no new proposals or implementation admissions this cycle. Capacity is saturated at 10/10 slots, 39 improvements await measurement, 21 requests failed, and only 6 outcomes are proven. Preserve the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement as the first revenue experiment after CTO releases capacity and site overlap clears. Baseline: 61 affiliate clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission for the available 2026-09-21 window. Prototype: clarify affiliate-entry CTA hierarchy and disclosure placement only. Metric: affiliate clicks and attributable outcomes over 14 days or 100 relevant impressions/clicks. Roll back the single CTA diff if validation or link health regresses; do not claim revenue or causal lift.

Deferred CRO opportunity after capacity release: rodhat.com SEO improvement for /tips/2026-09-02-scm-rights-fd-passing. Evidence: 79 impressions, position 7.1, 4 clicks, 0 sessions, 0 conversions. Smallest reversible prototype: one title/meta or internal-link refinement with existing measurement. Expected metric: impressions-to-click rate and sessions for the target URL. Time-to-learn: 14 days or 100 relevant impressions. Do not add tracking or infer revenue.

Product discovery remains research-only. markitdown has MIT licensing and bounded lab checks passed 8/8, but dependency behavior, parser accuracy, maintenance trajectory, supply-chain posture, and fleet-specific SEO lift remain unverified; smallest prototype would convert a fixed internal content sample in a disposable workspace and compare metadata/content extraction quality before any adoption decision. shadcn-ui/ui also has MIT licensing and passed 3/3 bounded checks, but framework compatibility, bundle impact, accessibility regressions, maintenance burden, and conversion lift remain unverified; smallest prototype would render one isolated CTA component against an existing site fixture. Mermaid is MIT-licensed with supported use-case evidence but no safe native checks; prototype only as an offline content-rendering fixture. No dependencies should be installed or production changes made this cycle.

Site-factory opportunity remains planning-only: complicated.work is the strongest scaffold candidate, but analytics are not configured and launch-readiness, legal, security, measurement, and preview gates are incomplete. After one delivery slot is released, complete exactly one readiness artifact covering audience, scope, content seed, SEO baseline, analytics/affiliate readiness, compliance, security, measurement, rollback, and preview-only controls. This is a time-to-learn gate, not a launch recommendation; do not publish, spend, add domains, or claim telemetry.
